schemaxis.hdf5/1.scope: Only named cases, recorded runtimes and tested lifecycle paths; no qualification beyond these records.

cases.scope: Baseline typed file: counts are range(-5, 3) in a 6x2 big-endian int16 array, so rows 1-3 are [1,4],[7,10],[13,16]; the attached time scale is linspace(0, 2.5, 6) giving 0.5, 1.0, 1.5 s.

Materially different project: run A /signal = 0.5..3.5 fills slots 0-3, run B /signal[1:4] = 5.5..7.5 fills slots 5-7, fill -999 elsewhere; float32 temperatures 293.15..294.5 within float32 relative precision 1e-7.

Adoption of a plain-h5py vendor export (superblock 0): six expectations hold and frames_kelvin is unmet because the frames are in counts. Storage audit: the 4 gzip chunks of 12 logical bytes are stored as 20 bytes each (48 logical, 80 allocated per h5py and h5ls), so frames_compressed is unmet at ratio 0.6.
frames = 10*(6t+3y+x); hyperslab t in {1,3}, y in {0,1}, x in {1,2} gives 70,80,100,110,190,200,220,230; the first-pixel column is 0,60,120,180 against time 0..0.75 ms.
Edited copy: the created mean series 25,85,145,205 is attached to the time scale (0..0.75 ms) and extracted with those coordinates.
Two tetrahedra in a 0.1 m cube corner: volumes 1/6 and 1/3 of 0.001 m^3 sum to 5e-4 m^3 with no inverted cell; three XDMF steps.
Batches of 2, 1 and 3 rows of width 3 give cumulative 2, 3 and 6 rows, each observed by both concurrent readers.
Run A signal 0.5..3.5 and run B 4.5..7.5 differ by 4 V in all four samples (> 0.5 V tolerance); the run attribute differs (a vs b).

New external raw file: big-endian uint16 range(1000, 250) over two 8-byte segments reads back 1000..2750; float16 keeps 0.5, 1.0, 1.5 and the half-precision maximum 65504; N-bit + gzip chunking on uint32.
Cross-file copy of a vendor acquisition group: the copied frames keep their copied time scale, so the first-pixel profile 0,60,120,180 carries time 0..0.75 ms.
Two MPI ranks: linspace 300..317 K over 6x3 elements sums to 5553 K (min 300, max 317); cell ids 100+7i for i<7 sum to 847; rank 0 writes rows 0-2 and rank 1 rows 3-5 (temperature) / 3-6 (ids).

grid = 0.5*(200i+j) over 3000x200 float64 (1600-byte rows); memoryBytes 65536 gives 40-row blocks, so the full extraction streams in 75 blocks; corner hyperslab rows 2990 and 2999, columns 198-199 = 0.5*(200i+j): 299099, 299099.5, 299999, 299999.5.
Two MPI ranks each read two of the four frames (10*(6t+3y+x)); the gathered extraction equals the serial values 0..230 and the first-pixel column 0,60,120,180.

Ordinary HDF5 link names with spaces, Unicode (°C, μ), punctuation (# , " & < >) and a leading dot: temperature 4x2 float32 [20.5,21; 22.25,23; 24.5,25; 26.75,27] under /Experiment 1 with scale Zeit (s) = 0,0.5,1,1.5; CSV headers quoted where they hold commas or quotes. Compound /Run #2, "warm" & <dry>/Messwerte fields "Zeit (s)" and "Druck, kPa" = (0, 101.25), (0.5, 101.5), extracted in requested (reversed) field order; /Kanal[2] = Druck = 1.5, 2.5, 3.5 kPa, sliced from index 1 through h5dump --no-compact-subset.

sensor-run.h5: state = IDLE, ACQUIRE, ACQUIRE, ACQUIRE, FAULT, IDLE; pressure (float32) = 101.325, 101.3, 101.27, 101.31, NaN, 101.4; counts (6x2, big-endian int16) = -5+3k. Rows in {ACQUIRE, FAULT} with finite pressure are 1-3: time 0.5/1.0/1.5 s, counts (1,4), (7,10), (13,16). Pressure > 101.305 compares stored float32 values: rows 0, 3, 5 (101.325, 101.31 stored as 101.30999755859375 > 101.305, 101.4). Events with level >= 100: sample 1, code OVR. FAULT rows with finite pressure: none (shape [0, 2]).

sensor-run.h5 /run/raw/counts: 6x2 big-endian int16 -5+3k in 3x2 chunks with shuffle, gzip 6 and Fletcher-32: two allocated chunks at offsets [0,0] and [3,0] whose stored bytes the host checksums, inflates and unshuffles to -5..10 and 13..28; their sizes add up to the 44 allocated bytes h5ls reports.

A new /archive/counts with the layout of /run/raw/counts (6x2 big-endian int16, 3x2 chunks, shuffle+gzip 6+Fletcher-32) receives both stored chunks unchanged: values -5+3k, and a fresh HDF5 chunk listing shows the same chunk digests and masks as the captured source.

Contiguous 2000x64 float64 grid g[i,j] = 64i + j read with a 1 MiB data sieve buffer: the strided column rows 0, 500, 1000, 1500 at column 5 are 5, 32005, 64005, 96005; the band rows 1000-1499 x columns 8-11 starts 64008; the extraction open reports the declared sieve size from its file access property list.

Attributes above the 64 KiB compact limit on the root (128x160 float32 pixel gains, 80 KiB), a group (256x160 uint16 dark frame 100+k, 80 KiB) and a dataset (9000 float64 lookup table 0..8999, 72 KiB), all objects tracking creation order: the dataset attributes read back as zeta, lookup table, alpha, units in creation order.

sensor-run.h5 /run/events records (sample uint32, level float64 kPa, code ascii[4], position float32[3]) = (1, 101.3, OVR, [0,0.5,1]), (4, 99.5, LOW, [1,1,1]). Field writes: level of record 1 -> 98.25; code+sample of both -> FIX/10, FIX/40; position of record 0 -> [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]; untouched members keep their stored values. A null-dataspace float64 /run/pending with units kPa is created (no shape, no values).
